quest.title: Cleansing Defilement
quest.description: Hanachirusato says that in order to complete the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual, one must break the barrier in 5 places and destroy the "defilement incarnate" that will then come forth. Besides Konda Village and the abandoned shrine, there are three other places where the barrier surrounds the Thunder Sakura roots: Chinju Forest, Araumi, and below the tidal flats outside the Kamisato Estate. She says that she will await you at the Thunder Sakura root below the well in Konda Village.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8, Mora x50000

talks.objective: Complete the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek! How did you... When did you... Why...

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: I was right to have my eye on you. You are indeed qualified to perform the Cleansing.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I was quite concerned as to your actions, and as to whether you could heal the roots or not, so I have been observing you a little. If I have offended you, please forgive me.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: You have helped me greatly already by being able to undo the barrier.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If she's been watching us all this time, that means...

choices.text: Are you reporting us to the authorities?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The authorities? Who do you mean?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, the people in charge of the whole Konda Village thing.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Are you referring to the matter that the people of Konda Village have hidden away?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I am loyal to Narukami Island, not some police station.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Besides, she... I have had dealings with Konda Village for a long time as well. If those families were to be cut off, I would not be able to face...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Please excuse me. Let us get back to business.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: As you may know, the Thunder Sakura trees symbolize the eternal watch of the Electro Archon, and they have the power to remove evil and purify the earth.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: However, the polluted tree roots will eventually be corroded, and these tainted sections will form tumors, one after another.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: That is why we must perform the Cleansing Ritual.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Unfortunately, my... physical condition, shall we say, prevents me from accomplishing this deed.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: There are several more barriers of this kind. Can I ask you to aid me... No, to aid this land?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Do not fret... Our priority is the cleansing.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see. I'll help.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Thank you, truly.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: As for the location of the next barrier, you can visit the abandoned shrine nearby. It's not far northeast of Konda Village.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Due to certain circumstances, I fear that I cannot go with you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How will we meet up, then?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "The sakura on the east and west banks differ in speed, and the flowers of the north and south branches vary their bloom."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: However, everything on this island is under her... Under the Sacred Sakura's shade. So long as petals still fall like snow upon this island, we will surely meet again.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I wish you all the best.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: As you can see, I am simply a shrine maiden who wishes to cleanse evil with your aid.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Again, the two of you have my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: I apologize. There are some things that become... a habit, perhaps.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are you following us again? Couldn't you just say hello?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, um, sorry. Paimon's tired from floating around too much... Paimon didn't mean to be rude.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: It is alright. The barrier here has been undone successfully, and thus does the Cleansing Ritual come a step closer to completion. Thank you very much.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's the deal with the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual, anyway? Is it the same as the "cleansing" you asked us to do earlier?

choices.text: Miss Inagi also mentioned this before...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Inagi? Is Miss Inagi a shrine maiden named Misato, by any chance?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Her name is Hotomi, Paimon thinks.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Ah, that's right. It has been such a long time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But she also said that the method has been lost.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Ah. Hmm... Well, it has been so long, after all...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: It is understandable. I mean, so much time has passed. Don't worry, I'm not angry. Yes, it's just my memory throwing a tantrum.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miss Masked Maiden does seem to be very angry, actually...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...Anyway, the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual is a rite of purification.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Thunder Sakura of Narukami Island can absorb the filth within the earth. But over time, that filth will accumulate.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: If too much filth accumulates, the Thunder Sakura may wither.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Therefore, it is necessary to perform some "minor purifications" on the roots of Thunder Sakura scattered in five places around Narukami Island every once in a while, and to set a barrier up. This way, they are given the power to remove the accumulated filth.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What about the Cleansing Ritual, then?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: When there is enough filth accumulated in the barrier, it becomes necessary to perform the Cleansing Ritual.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm-hmm, Paimon gets it! So, when performing the Cleansing Ritual, we'll need to use a ward to break the barrier over the tree roots.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: This is an excellent understanding of the situation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course! We've done it twice now, after all.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, those monsters that looked like samurai were...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: So, is that how they present themselves nowadays...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: They are the embodiment of the land's defilement. Once driven out of the roots by the ward, they will condense into a physical form.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Back then... Uh, I mean, according to past records, they would turn into kasha, inugami, black jades, umibouzu, raging flames, and other such things. And not all of them would harm people, either. For example, there were the tofu boys...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kasha? Tofu boys? What in the world are those?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Oh, people don't know about these creatures nowadays?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But now, they have all turned into ferocious ochimusha... What has happened to Inazuma?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Uh, so, what if the cleansing rituals aren't performed and the trees do wither?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: As I recall... I mean, the records say that the Thunder Sakura almost withered several hundred years ago.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Monsters raged unchecked then. Even the seas turned black. The Thunder Sakura tried their hardest to absorb all the evil and the filth, and they almost died in the process.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What happened then?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The things that came after... I'm really sorry, but I'm not too familiar with them.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Either way, the present situation tells me that the problem was resolved in the end. Someone performed the Cleansing Ritual.

choices.text: You mentioned that there are five places...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Thanks to your efforts, two root barriers have been undone. Next...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Having done and seen so much, the two of you must be tired and hungry. I have prepared some dishes. I hope you will like them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, it looks delicious! You might be wearing a mask, but you're the best shrine maiden in Inazuma for sure!

choices.text: Hooray for the best shrine maiden in the land!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Well then, please enjoy yourself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, this is great!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, now that Paimon thinks about it, we just ate so much, but it feels like we've eaten nothing at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miss Masked Maiden, did you...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: How could you suggest that I would do such a thing?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Regardless, please don't worry. These dishes were made with magic I secretly learned from the bake-danuki. They are absolutely harmless. Generally speaking.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The reason I have served you such suspicious... Well, delicious food, is to help heal the remaining roots.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Chinju Forest is also home to a ward and a root that requires cleansing. And I believe that an old friend of mine still dwells deep within that forest.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "You believe"?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: It was a very long time ago. I'm afraid that I'm not entirely sure if he remembers me. Or if he might hate me.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: He can't move freely, and he can't communicate with people, either. But after eating this, you should be able to communicate with him.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: That old friend of mine should be able to help you at least a little. So I did this, for the sake of the Cleansing Ritual.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The two of you have already twice demonstrated your honor, compassion, and skill.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Surely, you will finish this deed for the sake of this land's well-being, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Since Miss Masked Maiden says we have to, let's finish this fight!

choices.text: Are you two teaming up to tease me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! How could you say that?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What about the other roots?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Apart from Chinju Forest, there is a tree root at a place called Araumi.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I wonder if there are still people living there. I haven't been there for a long time.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The last one... is outside the Kamisato residence. There is a pit on a beach northeast of there, and the root is within.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I leave the Cleansing Ritual to you...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Please go ahead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Back there in the abandoned shrine, Miss Masked Maiden, we saw someone who looked just like you through the Memento Lens...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Her name was "Hanachirusato." Are you that Hanachirusato?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Indeed I am.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: H—Has Paimon been cheated?

choices.text: She said so in the beginning, you know...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Well, anyway, what was that all about?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I'm sorry. I never meant to hide anything from you. I've just never had a chance to explain.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Nor is now the right time either. I'm really sorry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... Fine, Paimon gets it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just let us know once you've got the chance, Miss Masked Maiden.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Right? {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Thank you very much.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Ah yes. One other thing. When you spoke of the "Memento Lens" earlier, what were you referring to...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...Th—That mirror, Hiroshi... He...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wh—What happened?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...*sigh*

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I lost my composure. Please forgive me. In that case, please keep this "Memento Lens" safe. It is a very precious instrument indeed.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Please do! It is very precious!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't worry, I'll be sure to look after it well...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: There are small fox statues in many different places. They are called Earth Kitsune. With the Memento Lens, one can summon forth scenes from the past at those statues' locations.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: If it can be of aid in your adventures, please make good use of the Memento Lens.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll use it well!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Please do, and protect it! Don't bump it against things, and remember to clean it regularly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, got it!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: That's good. Now then, if you'll excuse me, I must go.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How will we meet up?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "If the crimson sakura knows the pain of parting, it will forever stay."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Our fates shall surely be entwined like those of the Sakura Bloom.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Till our next meeting, I will be praying for your success beneath the well in Konda Village, where you successfully purified the Thunder Sakura root. I wish you all the best.

choices.text: I'll keep it safe, trust me.
You're the only one who's been calling her "Miss Masked Maiden"...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: You seem very sensitive to things of a mystical nature.

choices.text: It seems just a little bit off...
So, we found this book called the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Summary...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Which Paimon didn't understand at all!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: People can't read it nowadays? But it was written in the common tongue...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "People nowadays"? Hey, just how old are you?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Wha— H—Hey, that's very rude of you!

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: That was well done — whether it was dealing with Ioroi's illusory tricks, or the way you defeated those demons.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Or so Paimon might have said, but this trick of yours is getting real old, Miss Masked Maiden.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Ah, so I disappointed you, then? I apologize. I'll do better next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's no need to "do better" at trivial things like this...

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: That is true. So, as for Ioroi... Is he doing well?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even though he's been turned into stone.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I see...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Usually, when bake-danuki make a mess, we won't send anyone to deal with them as long as they don't cross the line. After all, although they are mischievous, they're kind-hearted and simple, just like children.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But when Ioroi dared to steal the ward for the Cleansing Ritual, well, that was enough to get him punished. Since the "Yougou Three" were mentioned in your story, then it was probably Kamuna... an onmyouji from a past age, who did the deed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miss Masked Maiden, are you Ioroi's kitsune friend?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...That's quite the compliment. He was actually talking about the daughter of the Hakushin bloodline, also known as the "Kitsune Saiguu." She was worshiped as the kitsune goddess in many places long ago.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Sky Kitsune and Earth Kitsune were once her emissaries. After she left, they all turned into stone statues to preserve their power and await her return — and when she does, they will all walk the Byakko Plain together once more.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Following her departure, the bloodline and mystical might of the kitsune on Narukami Island today have dwindled to less than one tenth of what they used to be...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ioroi said "Our contest isn't over yet!"

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Oh, that. This is what happened. Did you know that Ioroi's full name is "Ioroi, the Hidden Protector of the Grove"?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Ioroi may be dull and impish, but he is also kind and loyal. That's why the Kitsune Saiguu aimed to guide him to the right path a long time ago.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: In order to make sure that he would comply with the Electro Archon's rule, the Kitsune Saiguu set the two of them up and got Ioroi appointed as the Protector of the Grove. This made him responsible for the safety of the Chinju Forest.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: That's why, when the world became pitch black, the Kitsune Saiguu was worried that Ioroi might die while fighting against this inexorable evil in his capacity as protector of the forest.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: So she used a game of Hide-and-Seek, something the bake-danuki are good at, as a way to challenge him...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "Ioroi, whatever happens... they're all my magical tricks. Don't fall for them and don't show up," she said.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "Of course, you sneaky kitsune. I will definitely defeat you this time," said Ioroi. And that's how their endless contest began.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...So Ioroi is still waiting for her to come back and find him?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Based on what you said about Ioroi, that appears to be the case...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But after a while, Ioroi sensed that something was wrong and started wreaking havoc. He even stole the ward in an attempt to lure the Kitsune Saiguu out.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: He didn't realize that it was something required for the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. He just thought that it was a comb of some importance to the Kitsune Saiguu. Later on, Kamuna sealed him into stone due to that misstep.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What about the Kitsune Saiguu, then?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...She was swallowed up by the darkness. In the end, after that darkness was defeated, she returned to the great land of Narukami along with the soil.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And who are you then?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Me? As you can see, I am just "Hanachirusato." A shrine maiden who wants to borrow your strength to destroy these evils.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That wasn't my question...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miss Masked... Hanachirusato, it's really strange that you know so many things about the past that most people don't.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You even know how to use bake-danuki magic and cook tanuki dishes.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But you don't know much about the present.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's almost like you're someone from a few centuries ago...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We also saw someone who looked like you in some memories. She even had the same name as you...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You must be just like Ioroi, a bake-danuki who was sealed several centuries ago!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: N—No, that's not who I...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I inherited her memories. As for other things, please forgive me. I cannot speak of them yet.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I made you a promise, back there in the cave. So when the time comes, I will reveal everything.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do we do, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, if you say so, Paimon will have some faith in Miss Masked Maiden too!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Thank you for your understanding.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Now, we must part here for the time being.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Goodbye.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "We part in body alone, for our hearts drift with the clouds."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I will pray for your success beneath the well in Konda Village. I shall be next to the Thunder Sakura root that you cleansed successfully.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: When the tree roots at all five places have been cleansed, please look for me there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But he's very well!

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Although it is a pity that we are unable to meet where the sun shines for now, the light from the Thunder Sakura, which symbolizes the divine, and the light from your aura are enough to illuminate this space. If there is anything I can help you with, please let me know.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Apart from Chinju Forest, there is a barrier in a place called Araumi.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Finally, there is a pit on a beach northeast of the Kamisato residence's courtyard. That is where you will find the final barrier.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: In the past, the ward was guarded by the Sky Kitsune. But after everything changed, the Sky and Earth Kitsune eventually refused to show up, instead sleeping and waiting for her return.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: If you want to find the ward, look for the Sky Kitsune around the seal... that should be a special fox statue. If you're having difficulties, try to find the Earth Kitsune nearby, or use that Lens to see if there are any clues.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I'm afraid I don't know much more about this than you. Apart from the Hiiragi Clan's squandering of their divine gift, that is...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: There are many sleeping Earth Kitsune in Narukami Island. What you may see before you, though, is most likely to be a small, special fox statue.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: In the past, though they were weak in strength, they valued loyalty. If you look at them through the Memento Lens, you should be able to see some scenes from the past.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "Our hearts drift with the clouds..."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: If there is anything I can help you with, please do not hesitate to let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. I wish you all the best.
